subject: Guest Wi-Fi network down at Saket location
description: The guest Wi-Fi network at ServeWell - Saket has been down since this morning. Customers are unable to connect to the network and are complaining about lack of internet access. The NetLink router (RTR-0023-01) appears to be powered on, but the guest SSID is not broadcasting. No changes were made to the network configuration recently. This is affecting customer experience during peak hours.
